scope: Role, orientation and data-* of the web component in happy-dom and of the React renderer in react-dom/server (node:test), and their state parity. Rendered thickness is covered by the browser geometry check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: key notation, caps, spoken label, resolver

limitations: React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html compares the React Kbd with ui-kbd at five sizes ("fails": []).
The source list is the direct sources, not every transitive dependency.

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-06): 2 height, gap, padding and text derive from u; 3 a cap is a fixed 5u mark with no slots; 4 no construction-pattern parts; 5 no border except in forced colors; 6 radius u × scale, capped at half the height; 7 text is 10 + ½u at line height 1; 8 the ½u gap is fixed; 9 no floating layer; 10 a long key name grows its cap; 11 no focus stop.
